data.name: Intro_Text
data.value: Fill in the requested inputs for each OSR stream. Add or remove streams as needed to match your context. Once you have entered all available data, go to the Prioritisation tab to see the headline results and start sequencing streams for reform planning.

data.name: FinancialYear_Tooltip
data.value: The financial year selected on the Quick Analysis. All monetary figures on this page are reported for this period.

data.name: AddStreamModal_Step1Intro
data.value: Choose a template to get started, or select "Other" to classify manually.

data.name: AddStreamModal_SubgroupLabel
data.value: Which type of non-property revenue stream are you analysing?

data.name: AddStreamModal_SubgroupHelp
data.value: Choose the option that best reflects how this revenue is billed or collected.

data.name: AddStreamModal_SubgroupNote
data.value: Classify by how the revenue is administered, not only by its local name. A billed waste fee would fall under service fees, while a daily market ticket would fall under daily charges.

data.name: AddStreamModal_SubtypeLabel
